query:
SELECT
            u.is_managed,
            can_manage_person($1, u.id) AS "is_manager!",
            EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM family_mems t JOIN family_mems v ON v.family_id = t.family_id
                WHERE t.user_id = u.id AND v.user_id = $1
            ) AS "is_relative!"
        FROM users u
        WHERE u.id = $2
